scope: Complete the runtime-limited format cell, obtain held-out task-format validity, replicate the pretrained utility audit across seeds, and test a Llama architecture.

equals_format_completion.purpose: Complete the previously preregistered cell. The format has already failed its competence gate, so this cell cannot reverse that verdict.

heldout_format_selection.competence_gate: A candidate must have baseline accuracy at least 0.40 at five pairs and 0.25 at 20 pairs.
heldout_format_selection.selection_rule: Among passing candidates, select the highest mean baseline accuracy across the two pilot lengths, then the highest worst-length accuracy, then candidate-list order.
heldout_format_selection.outcome_blinding: The pilot reads only natural baseline accuracy and margin. It does not run or inspect causal interventions.

full_evaluation.success_gate: The selected format remains naturally competent at a completed length, source-max minus distractor control has positive mean margin at at least two lengths, source-min has negative mean margin at at least two lengths, and invariant error is below 1e-6.

utility_seed_replication.success_gate: For each model, the pooled source-max first-order term has positive rank association with the exact effect and the mean exact source-max effect retains its prior direction. Model, length, seed, and nonlinear residuals remain visible.

llama_family_replication.smoke_gate: The backend has finite logits and attentions and the model has baseline accuracy at least 0.25 at five pairs in a 32-example competence pilot.

full_evaluation.success_gate: Source-max minus distractor control has positive mean margin at at least two lengths, source-min has negative mean margin where baseline competence is nontrivial, and invariant error is below 1e-6.

llama_family_replication.fallback_rule: Use TinyLlama only if SmolLM2 fails backend compatibility or the locked competence gate.
